summary: Pangasinan 6th District representative with 52 principal-authored bills. Authored a prohibition on privatizing public health facilities, comprehensive renal replacement therapy, LGU earmarking for health services, a universal social pension (two bills), solo-parent financial assistance, early voting for seniors and PWDs and a higher campaign expenditure limit with a definition of independent candidates. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Early-voting and campaign-expenditure bills are a single electoral-rules issue and democratic institutions is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored prohibiting privatization of public health facilities (-4), renal therapy and LGU health earmarks (-3), a universal social pension and solo-parent assistance (-3); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2).
